method: R17 historical diagnostics and prior-period calibration on fixed R16 candidate B, outside-eight 4059 targets and 240 receipt targets. All variants retained; no new trade gates; negative league set follows R16 observed loss, so retrospective subgroup selection. Calibration excludes all 1393 receipt IDs, uses only same-league earlier outcomes; original eight unmodified. Intercept and ridge100 intercept/slope around original rate experimental. No independent forward claim.
